requirement: Specify an executable same-period source-address comparison and a narrow exploratory address-model evaluation.
unit: Unique decoded Bitcoin input source address; one frozen reference transaction and prior-block feature cutoff per address.

primary_target.name: known_coldcard_core_membership
primary_target.positive: One of the fixed 500 exact source/payment records in the pinned case view.
primary_target.comparison: A selected source address outside the 505 saved case-related sources and collector, active as an input in the same four blocks. Operational membership target=0; compromise and device status remain unknown.
primary_target.scope: Retrospective within-window exploratory case association. Not a theft, device-brand or prospective detector.

comparison_selection.universe: All unique nonempty decoded prevout source addresses of positive-valued inputs of non-coinbase transactions in the four anchored complete blocks; not output recipients.
comparison_selection.reference: First occurrence ordered by block height then lexical TXID. The cutoff is the block height, so within-block TXID tie-breaking does not affect predictor inclusion.
comparison_selection.exclusions: All 505 registry source addresses and the known collector; unresolved input scripts remain counted as unresolved, never assigned an address or benign label.
comparison_selection.ranking: Within the first-occurrence block, ascending SHA256(hash_prefix + address), then address for an exact hash tie; no balance/age/fee/model-score filtering.
comparison_selection.shortfalls: Take all available sources in a short stratum; report underfill. No borrowing across blocks or replacement after history failures.
comparison_selection.publication: Commit hashed source/payment records and aggregate audits. Reconstruct exact selected identifiers locally from the block cache.

history_collection.cutoff: Confirmed history heights strictly less than reference block; omit entire reference block and future.
history_collection.coverage: Exhausted pagination with stable matching provider counters; reuse pinned exact raw histories when available. No cryptographic inclusion claim.
history_collection.failure_policy: Retain errors/incomplete histories, null features and selected identifiers; do not replace or silently retry. Compare completion and page-limit attrition by membership and stratum before fitting.

predictor_exclusions: Everything outside features, especially reference-payment inputs/fees/recipient/UTXO depletion, block height/time, raw identifiers, case/device/report labels and collection artifacts.

evaluation.design: Exploratory within-window grouped development only; current case profiles were already inspected. Not an untouched or independent-incident test.
evaluation.groups: Connected components across repeated source addresses, shared prior-transaction references, common reference TXID and identical full fourteen-feature vectors. These groups prevent measured overlap; they are not ownership claims. Preserve the incident metadata separately.
evaluation.partition: After all selected histories and attrition audit, assign each component by SHA256(coldcard-source-split-v1:42: + lexical minimum address_sha256 in component) modulo 10: residues 0-6 train, 7 validation, 8-9 test. Freeze once; no seed/group rerolls or splitting large components.
gates: Complete input census and all 500 positive source/payment anchors agree before sampling
Comparison histories exist and all completed vectors reproduce with the unchanged extractor
Report fixed-selection attrition by membership/block; retain incomplete rows outside fitting

At least 20 rows of each membership class in each partition and no component/shared prior reference/reference TXID/full feature vector crossing partitions; otherwise report infeasibility without resampling
Preprocessing fit only on train; validation/test frozen; no tuning on test
evaluation.preprocessing: Training medians per feature, zero fallback only for an all-missing training column, plus one fixed missingness indicator per original feature. Never replace undefined fee rates with reference-payment fees.

learned_baseline.selection: One prespecified tree, no parameter search. Shallow tree for transparent rules on fourteen tabular features; no graph features yet justify a GNN.

evaluation.metrics: Report sampled-cohort membership prevalence, AP and ROC-AUC; membership precision/recall/F1 at fixed tree score >=0.5 with explicit membership name. These are not theft/device precision, F1 or calibrated probabilities. Constant and univariate comparators use ranking metrics only; tree ties include equality at threshold.
evaluation.interpretation: Complete-case, selected-population exploratory results. The 2:1 comparison design sets sampling prevalence; do not infer prevalence/calibration for the blockchain. One Coldcard incident cannot evaluate independent-incident transfer.
evaluation.model_outputs: case_membership_score, not theft_probability; include rules, support counts, errors and missingness reliance. Original external 19-feature forest remains frozen.

method_sources.purpose: Shallow-tree parameter meanings; exact values are our design choices

execution_scope: This unit validates the design and implements the selector. No real comparison sample, history requests, split or fitted model is claimed without its own saved execution.
